declarations: System picked from each name's own picture: position system (C26-C30, R13-R15); lane not used.
Declared proxies: swing highs and EMA grid stand in for the resistance line; red D bar = trend-colour flip (R15). cmf and bar_high levels read by field only.
C21 is a house rule, not Seow's.

answers.text: "W 7.4% above its last swing high" is a late buy: that is O'Neil's test, not mine. Position system: strength is the signal (C26); W swing_class HH/HL, H1 at the 20-hr high, D swing_class HH but LL is a caution I named. Volume pivot proof is not my menu. Stands.

trigger.plain: Buy stop one tick over yesterday's high, trailed to each new prior-day high.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d), the support line.
decisions.reason: Position system, picture is a held break: D swing_class HH/HL, W swing_class HH/HL at 0.4% above the last swing high, D close 2.5% under the 20-day high. TIF proxy weaker (H1 swing_class LH/LL); caution only. Take the signal (C19, C26, C27).

trigger.plain: Buy stop one tick over yesterday's high, trailed daily until it fills.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d), the support line.
decisions.reason: Position system, fresh break: D swing_class HH/HL at 1.0% above the last swing high, W swing_class HH/HL at 9.1% above; strength is the signal (C26). H1 swing_class HH but LL, 35% of day's range is timing, not my test.

trigger.plain: Wait for a daily close above yesterday's high; the last D bar is red.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d), the support line.
decisions.reason: Position system, held break: W, D, H1 all HH/HL, D 2.7% under the 20-day high. But D last_bar red is my trend-colour flip proxy (R15); the colour must turn first, then the buy stop (C14, C27).

trigger.plain: Wait for a daily close above yesterday's high; D last bar red, H1 below EMA9.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d), the support line.
decisions.reason: Position system, fresh break: W 0.2% above the last swing high, D swing_class HH/HL. D last_bar red and H1 close_vs_ema9 below mean the colour has not confirmed; wait, then buy stop.

trigger.plain: Buy stop one tick over yesterday's high, trailed daily until it fills.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d), the support line.
decisions.reason: Position system, fresh break: W swing_class HH/HL, H1 swing_class HH/HL at the 20-hr high, D 3.1% under the 20-day high. D swing_class HH but LL and thin volume are cautions, not rejects.

trigger.plain: Hold; add on the next signal via buy stop over yesterday's high (30% then 20%).

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d), the support line. Or a red bar then a sell below its low.
decisions.reason: Held, position system: W, D, H1 swing_class HH/HL, D 0.3% above the last swing high, D last_bar green so no exit flip. Add only on a later signal (C30).

trigger.plain: Wait for a daily close above the last pivot high before any add.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d), the support line. Or a red bar then a sell below its low.
decisions.reason: Held, no break yet: D 3.3% under the last swing high, W 0.9% under, all HH/HL, D last_bar green so no exit. Position system needs the break first (C26); add only then.
